ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. No class meeting on November 20. The course will be taught via Collaborate v.11 and Compass. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
